verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only entity-level deletion: scenarios can be deleted (make-docs-26), AI Agents have delete endpoints (make-docs-37), and data stores, which hold scenario data, are manageable via the API and MCP server (make-docs-29, make-docs-14). Nothing in the pack covers retention policies or controls over how long execution and run data is kept. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods for execution logs and scenario history, account- or org-level data deletion and purge controls, documented retention policy, independent corroboration.
